rationale: The two text-bearing records flatly contradict each other and must never share a story; that part is decidable and is all the ground truth asserts. The middle record carries the same headline and no standfirst, so the evidence present does not say which of the two it is a copy of - it is listed as indeterminate rather than assigned, and no pair involving it is scored. exact_stage_partition records separately that M2 attaches it to the endpoint it reaches first, which is an implementation traversal detail and not a human judgement.

cross_fixture_claims.note: Same shape as P117: one headline, opposite results in the standfirst.

Nvidia reports quarterly segment results

rationale: The same shape as C001 with the contradiction removed: the two text-bearing records agree and the middle one is silent. Here the sparse record's placement is determinate, because there is only one story for it to belong to. Missing information is not disagreement, so all three are one syndicated story with three outlets. This is the case a guard that vetoed on absence would break.

cross_fixture_claims.note: Same shape as P007: one headline on two outlets, neither supplying a standfirst that disagrees.

items.title: AMD lifts its data centre outlook for the year
AMD lifts its data centre outlook for the year
AMD lifts its data centre outlook for the year

rationale: Human ground truth and quarantine policy are different questions and this case records both. As articles, the first and third records are one story - byte-identical headline, no standfirst on either, twenty minutes apart - and the second is a different recall of a different model for a different fault. That is expected_partition. Separately, all three were emitted by one feed under a single provider item id, and because that identity describes two different articles the feed is wrong about something; M2 cannot tell which record is right, so it quarantines every item under the identity and emits three singletons. That is exact_stage_partition. Scoring against ground truth therefore shows an under-merge, which is the honest cost of the policy rather than a defect in it.

rationale: Three independently written headlines about one earnings event. A reader groups all three. rationale: An earnings release, a syndicated copy of it, and an executive interview about the same numbers published the same evening. The first two are one story. That is the same relationship P152 records, and it takes P152's label rather than being left open - the article-level contract settles it, and a cluster fixture must not contradict a pair fixture about the same relationship.
